entitySuffixRule: Must contain the words "limited liability company" or "limited company," or the abbreviations "l.l.c.," "l.c.," "llc," or "lc." The word "limited" may be abbreviated "ltd." and "company" may be abbreviated "co."
distinguishabilityNote: Must be distinguishable on the records of the Secretary of State from the name of any business corporation, nonprofit corporation, limited partnership, or limited liability company organized or reserved in Montana; from any foreign entity of those types registered or qualified here; from any assumed business name, limited partnership name, trademark, service mark, or other name registered or reserved with the Secretary of State; and from the corporate name of a dissolved domestic corporation for 120 days after its dissolution takes effect. The name may also not contain business name identifiers (defined in § 30-13-201) or other language stating or implying that the company is a business other than a limited liability company. Section 35-8-103(3) and (4) route the use of another company's name, and contests over registered names, to § 35-14-401, whose subsection (3) is the only escape: the Secretary of State authorizes a name that is not distinguishable if the other holder consents in writing and undertakes to change its own name, or if the applicant delivers a certified copy of a final court judgment establishing its right to the name.
nameReservationCostBasis: The $10 Secretary of State fee for a name reservation is the full cost.
notes: Montana's LLC Act (Mont. Code Ann. Title 35, ch. 8) sets a distinctive rule: § 35-8-103(1)(b) bars a name from containing the "business name identifiers" of another entity type, which § 30-13-201(2) defines as words describing the type or form of a business, including but not limited to corporation, partnership, limited partnership, limited liability company, limited liability partnership, association, and their abbreviations. An LLC name therefore cannot carry "Inc.," "Corp.," "LP," or similar. There is otherwise no general banned-word list. A reservation under § 35-8-104(2) runs for a nonrenewable 120 days and may be transferred, though a transfer does not extend the term. Montana is one of the cheapest states to form in: the LLC filing fee is $35 and the annual report carries no fee when filed by April 15 ($35 after).
